descripcion:
Netflix raising prices: why is Netflix so expensive now? Netflix said it in its own words. In its Q4 2024 letter to shareholders, filed with the SEC as an exhibit to an 8-K, Netflix wrote: "we will occasionally ask our members to pay a little more."

How much did Netflix make? Its 10-K for 2024, the annual report every public company files with the SEC, lists net income of $8,711,631,000. Net income is the profit left after all costs and taxes: about $8.7 billion.

This short zooms in on both lines, straight from the filings. "A little more", next to $8.7 billion. A little.

Sources: Netflix Q4 2024 shareholder letter (8-K, Ex. 99.1); Netflix Form 10-K for 2024.
